testcase.name: fresh migration creates a durable single installation and no users, sessions or fixtures
reruns preserve installation identity and existing owner/project data across new connections
two concurrent migrators apply exactly once and produce one installation
failure on first install rolls back schema, ledger and installation together
failed upgrade preserves the previous identity, data and migration ledger
changed checksum and newer unknown migration histories block further migration
a busy migration lock fails within the bounded timeout and can be retried
database constraints enforce one installation and one owner under concurrent inserts
workspace/project compound foreign keys reject cross-workspace environments
project slugs are constrained and unique within each workspace
session records require hashes, valid lifetime ordering and an owned workspace
a readiness-only runtime role can read the ledger but cannot modify it
real database readiness detects migration state and never reports authentication ready
